title: Alpha3 local-window geometry search
research_question: Can Alpha3 close its remaining ECG200 accuracy gap to the MLP by changing how the 96-sample signal is partitioned, while retaining the compact k=[1,2] basis?
hypothesis: The fixed 8-sample local receptive field may limit temporal representation. A different contiguous window geometry can improve TRAIN-only validation accuracy without sacrificing compactness or stability.
design_note: All candidates preserve a 96-feature concatenated representation before the 96->2 Q.ANT Fourier/KAN head. This changes temporal receptive-field geometry rather than downstream feature dimensionality.

data_protocol.rule: Reuse the deterministic TRAIN-only validation boundary from prior selection experiments. Canonical TEST remains untouched until a candidate is frozen.

primary_metric: Mean validation Q.ANT accuracy across 10 seeds.
selection_rule: Highest mean validation Q.ANT accuracy; tie-break by lower standard deviation, then fewer parameters.
success_criteria: A non-control geometry must exceed w8_control by at least 0.02 absolute mean validation Q.ANT accuracy and have standard deviation no more than 0.01 absolute above control.
promotion_scope: Success selects a candidate for a separate full-TRAIN confirmation; Exp010 alone does not replace Alpha3.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
